messages.text: The new real-link fixture found three exact Windows rules: type-sort ties are case-sensitive, classification does not append `@` to symlinks, and `--dereference` suppresses the displayed link target even though the Windows attribute row remains link-shaped. I’m applying those rules and excluding the freshly created symlink from the relative-time fixture so that elapsed seconds cannot make the verifier nondeterministic; then I’ll perform the final build and entrypoint audit.
